one_liner: Salesforce is a cloud-based CRM platform (the "#1 AI CRM") that lets businesses manage sales, service, marketing and commerce data and build AI agents on top of it.

auth.notes: Salesforce exposes OAuth2 via Connected Apps / External Client Apps with Consumer Key/Secret, scopes (full, refresh_token, openid), and IP-allowlist controls for refresh tokens.

evidence.snippet: Add OAuth scopes. The default auth config requests `full`, `refresh_token`, and `openid`

access.notes: A free Salesforce Developer Edition org can be signed up for without payment, approval or sales contact, and OAuth credentials (Consumer Key/Secret) can be created self-serve inside that org.

evidence.snippet: If you don't have an org to test in, sign up for a free [Salesforce Developer Edition](https://developer.salesforce.com/signup).
